newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms vs dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed afternoon trade firmer against the dollar on Thursday after large dollar/mark fluctations caused hectic price movements on the Budapest interbank forex market, dealers said.
The forint moved within a 40 filler range and ended afternoon trade at 181.00/05, compared to a midday level of 181.26 and an opening of 180.80/85.
"The end of the day saw some excitement after the Buba statements and U.S. figures which dampened the dollar/mark," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.

Buba president Tietmeyer commented Buba was not interested in further mark weakening, while the U.S. Fed's Rivlin said the rising dollar helped contain inflation but hurts exports. The U.S. March trade deficit was also published Thursday and was above forecasts.
Behan said the hectic movements were deterring trade in the forint. "It's a nervous, liquid market, nobody wants to get their fingers burned," he said.
As a result the forint remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level all day.

The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark. -- Duncan Shiels, Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 4040
